name: Welcome To The Salty Spitoon
look: Four panels in a 2x2 grid from SpongeBob SquarePants. The huge gray-blue bouncer of the Salty Spitoon, in a tiny sailor hat, questions a tough fish with a green headband and a MOM heart tattoo. The bouncer asks, squints skeptically, glares in close-up, and finally the tough guy answers wide-eyed.
use: A toughness contest: the bouncer asks how tough someone is, the guy brags about something hardcore, the bouncer is unimpressed, and the guy adds an even more extreme detail.
slots: the bouncer's question, "how tough are ya?" (top left)
the even tougher extra detail (bottom right)
examples: I ate a whole ghost pepper
Welcome to the Salty Spitoon, how tough are ya?
